name: Stainless Steel Hand Wash Station
description:
A self-contained commercial  hand wash station that doesn't need plumbing. It works well in clinics, hospitals, food processing plants, restaurants, schools, construction sites and offices. It has a sturdy stainless steel body that is easy to clean and resists rust.

Features:
	•	20-litre water tank
	•	Stainless steel basin and tap
	•	Liquid soap dispenser fitted
	•	Paper towel dispenser fitted
	•	Lockable storage cabinet underneath
	•	Mobile, so you can move it wherever it's needed

Ideal for: health facilities, food handling areas, events, workplaces and public spaces.
